subject: Re: Request for Paper Acceptance Status
body:
[HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED]

Dear Maria Chen,

Thank you for your inquiry regarding the acceptance status of your paper submission for ICCBDA 2027.

We are unable to provide individual acceptance results by email. Personal acceptance results can only be checked through the submission system. Please check your paper status through the ICCBDA 2027 submission system. This matter requires review by the conference secretariat.

For further assistance, please contact the conference secretariat at iccbda2027@example.org.

Best regards,
ICCBDA 2027 Organizing Committee
review_reason: Personal paper acceptance decisions must not be disclosed by email and require human handling; acceptance status can only be checked through the submission system.
